changelog:
Initial release of Agent Browser – a powerful Rust-based, CLI-driven headless browser automation tool for AI agents, with Node.js fallback.

- Enables navigation, clicking, typing, form filling, and DOM snapshots via structured CLI commands.
- Supports extraction of structured page data and robust automation flows.
- Includes features for screenshots, video recording, PDF export, semantic locators, cookies/storage management, tab/window/frame control, and network interception.
- Offers both npm and source installation options.
- Detailed command set for flexible web UI testing and automated web interactions.
